page_title: LYO 2-1 STR | Lyon v Strasbourg 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Eric Wattellier is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' The manager makes a subsitution with Mathys de Carvalho (Lyon) coming on for Tanner Tessmann.
90+6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) was quite harsh and Eric Wattellier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+5' Lyon seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
90+3' Here is a change. Lucas Hogsberg is going off and Liam Rosenior gives the last tactical orders to Kendry Paez (Strasbourg).
90+1' 2 - 1 An excellent first touch by Afonso Moreira (Lyon), who collects a splendid pass and from the edge of the box slams the ball into the top right corner!
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Martial Godo (Strasbourg) will replace Diego Moreira.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Tyler Morton (Lyon) launches a cross from the corner, but Mike Penders is alert to thwart the effort.
88' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Rachid Ghezzal (Lyon) but poses no threat.
86' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) works the corner short.
83' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) plays a through ball but overhits it.
80' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Eric Wattellier had an easy-decision to make.
79' Rachid Ghezzal (Lyon) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
77' Paulo Fonseca has decided to substitute Pavel Sulc and he is replaced by Martin Satriano (Lyon).
77' Substitution. Adam Karabec makes his way off the pitch and Rachid Ghezzal (Lyon) comes on as his replacement.
77' Liam Rosenior decides to make a substitution. Julio Enciso will be replaced by Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg).
77' It's time for a substitution. Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) comes on in place of Samir El Mourabet.
74' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) commits a foul and Eric Wattellier immediately signals a free kick.
73' Adam Karabec (Lyon) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
72' Adam Karabec (Lyon) is about to take a corner kick.
72' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Lyon get a corner.

71' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
70' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Eric Wattellier blows for a foul.
68' Paulo Fonseca is forced to make a change. Malick Fofana is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Afonso Moreira (Lyon).
68' Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
67' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.
67' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg)! Let's see what he decides.
67' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) for his blatant foul.
63' Lyon are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
61' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
57' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
56' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
56' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Dominik Greif scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
49' Adam Karabec (Lyon) tackles a bit over-zealously and Eric Wattellier blows for a foul.
47' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Strasbourg take a short corner kick.
45+1' Lyon failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
43' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots low to the middle of the goal, but only into the gloves of a well-prepared Mike Penders.
42' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
40' Referee Eric Wattellier is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Lyon!
39' Celebrations by Lyon are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
39' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle and signals a foul after Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) brought his opponent down. The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Lyon!!
35' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) is furious with himself for wasting a glorious chance. He got to a rebound inside the 6-yard box, but his header went narrowly wide of the left post.
34' Adam Karabec (Lyon) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
34' Adam Karabec (Lyon) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Lyon have a corner.
31' 1 - 1 This is definitely not what Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 1:1.
30' The referee blows his whistle as Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) was too aggressive in his challenge.

28' Lyon slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
25' 0 - 1 Goal! Guela Doue swings the ball deep into the box and finds Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
21' Eric Wattellier couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) and blew his whistle.

20' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Strasbourg are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
19' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.

17' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
15' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Eric Wattellier stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
15' Adam Karabec (Lyon) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

13' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Mike Penders pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
13' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
12' Adam Karabec (Lyon) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
8' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) makes a strong challenge and Eric Wattellier blows for a foul.
8' Wonderful movement by Lyon. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
6' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
2' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
2' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle. Pavel Sulc (Lyon) commits a foul after dangerous play.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Lyon will kick-off.
Eric Wattellier will officiate today.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
